original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 36 Management Device Threshold Data structure against the approved component-specific threshold definition and association topology.
original_method: Preserve existing evidence, collect complete raw Type 36 plus its referring Type 35 and associated component structure through protected read-only access, decode all six threshold words, apply the component-defined unit and validate unavailable sentinels without changing threshold state.
manual_activity: The platform/BMC owner supplies the expected Type 35-to-Type 36 association, associated component type and unit, and approved six-value threshold matrix; an operator verifies target identity and protected access while automation performs the comparison.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/board, BIOS, SMBIOS and management-controller identity
Expected Type 36 handle and all six threshold words
Referring Type 35 Threshold Handle and associated component handle/type
Allowed 8000h unavailable fields and threshold ordering policy
Supported parser, redaction and protected evidence policy
safety_requirements: Keep collection read-only; do not set or probe thresholds
Do not change BMC, sensor, fan, power or firmware settings
Do not clear dmesg, syslog or SEL before preserving relevant evidence
Never put passwords on the command line or disable host-key verification
Capture full Type 36 plus referring Type 35 and associated component records
Treat 8000h as unavailable rather than a numeric threshold
Do not fabricate linked-device, unit or status fields inside Type 36
agent_execution_scope: Validate target and owner-approved Type 36 matrix
Collect complete Type 36, referring Type 35 and associated component records through protected access
Parse all six threshold words and preserve raw hexadecimal values
Resolve the Type 35 reference and derive units only from the associated component type
Validate sentinel use and owner-approved ordering/ranges
Report discrepancies without mutation or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve association, unit, sentinel and threshold matrix
Resolve absent, duplicate, vendor-specific or safety-significant values
Review evidence and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Type 36 selector matches the source, but grep hides every threshold and sshpass/disabled host checking weakens security and target identity; source log clearing is rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through protected access collect unfiltered Type 36 plus referring Type 35 and associated component structures, then validate the six threshold words, 8000h sentinel, association and component-defined units; do not mutate thresholds or clear logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Type 36 scope, SPEC comparison, private script and 10/10-minute estimates remain; evidence-clearing boilerplate is not executed.

modernized_recommendation.status: TYPE36 SIX-VALUE MATRIX AND ASSOCIATION REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For each Type 36 handle, retain the six raw words, map its referring Type 35 association to the probe/cooling component, derive the specified unit from that component type, and compare each available value with the approved matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact field/sentinel parsing and cross-structure unit context while removing GPT V2's implication that Type 36 embeds a linked-device, unit or status field.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A structure heading cannot reveal any threshold, and isolated decimal values cannot establish their component, unit or validity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS threshold declarations do not prove live sensor readings or enforcement behavior; live management tests require separate authorization.

project_override_considerations: A Project may accept 8000h only for owner-approved unavailable fields. Range/order checks must use the associated component's unit and encoding; BMC data is supplemental and cannot replace exact SMBIOS association evidence.
expected_evidence: Redacted SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS/BMC identity, timestamp and approved Type 36 matrix
Complete raw Type 36, referring Type 35 and associated component output with exit status
All six raw threshold words and explicit 8000h handling
Per-record association, component type, derived unit and matrix comparison
Engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, Criteria and Type 36 selector agree. GPT V2's extra field model is guidance corrected from the official schema and does not alter Master source identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The comparison is deterministic once the owner provides the Type 35 association, component-defined units, sentinel policy and expected six-value matrix.

review_improvement: Replaces a heading-only check with all-six-threshold validation, exact unavailable-sentinel handling and schema-correct cross-structure unit/association resolution.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 36 stores six raw threshold values but no component handle, unit or status. Meaning comes from a Type 35 Threshold Handle and the associated probe/cooling component; therefore both an orphan check and component-specific decoding are prerequisites to any numerical comparison.
